result.description: Fires on hedging/minimizing adverbs such as " essentially", " simply", " merely" and " literally", mostly directly before a verb or predicate (means, represent, serves as). Members are mainly detectors of these adverb tokens.
result.label: Essentially/simply/merely adverbs

result.description: Fires on abstract social-topic nouns or adjectives (' political', ' change', ' interaction(s)', ' ideas') in lists of social/cultural themes, especially in text about music as a vehicle for social change. Silent on 'political' in other generic social-systems contexts.
result.label: Social/political theme words in music-society text

result.description: Fires on word pieces in biology/chemistry science terms, mainly ' chrom' (chromosome/chromatography), 'omer' in Isomerase/Isomerism, ' II' in meiosis phases, and ' pol' (poles). Needs a technical science context; silent on abstract physics text.
result.label: Biochemistry word pieces (chrom, omer, II)

result.description: Fires on ' by' right after "replaced" (passive replacement, e.g. "traditional methods were replaced by"), and weakly on the following word. Silent on ' by' after other verbs like "driven by" or "monitored by".
result.label: 'by' after 'replaced'

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " ret" (retailer, retail, retention, retina), where more letters must follow. Members are detectors of " ret" plus related word-start pieces. Weak activity on "qui" and "df".
result.label: Word-start piece " ret"

result.description: Fires on the digit '4' as the third digit of a year in the 1400s, such as 1443, 1449 or 1475. It stays silent on '4' in other year positions or other digit contexts.
result.label: '4' in 14xx years

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' patterns', ' the', ' to', verbs like 'understand') in academic descriptions of scientific fields (geography, epidemiology, climate, energy). It is silent on ' patterns' in some climate contexts, so the evidence is mixed and the condition is unclear.
result.label: Academic science text, mixed function-word positions

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' sequ' (sequential, sequencing, sequenced), predicting continuations like 'ential', 'enced', 'encing'. Members are mostly ' sequ' detectors, plus a few other word-start pieces.
result.label: ' sequ' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word "random" or "randomly" (also randomization pieces), mostly in statistics and sampling text such as random sampling, random assignment, random forest. It pushes toward words like sampling, generator, assignment.
result.label: ' random' / ' randomly' token
